description:
Add the Electron main-process supervisor that spawns, monitors, and shuts down the helper binary per N-007 §§9–11, and the JSON-RPC client that speaks Boundary B. No renderer changes in this ticket — the preload/renderer wiring lands in T-014.

Scope (binding):
- Add a `electron/engine-supervisor.ts` (name negotiable) that owns the helper lifecycle:
  - Computes socket path: Linux/macOS `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cove-screen-recorder/engine.sock`, Windows `\\.\pipe\cove-screen-recorder-<uidHash>` (per N-007 §4.1). Falls back to `${app.getPath('temp')}/cove-screen-recorder/engine.sock` if `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` is unset.
  - Computes PID file path: `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cove-screen-recorder/engine.pid`.
  - Resolves helper binary path: in dev, `target/debug/cove-replay-engine`; in packaged builds, `process.resourcesPath/helper/cove-replay-engine[.exe]`. Resolution is wrapped behind a single function for T-010d to audit.
  - Implements the orphan/adopt logic from N-007 §10.1 verbatim: alive same-user same-comm helper → adopt; dead PID → unlink + spawn; alive different-user helper → refuse with `helper-pid-collision`.
  - Spawns the helper with `child_process.spawn(helperBinary, ['--ipc-socket', socketPath, '--log-dir', logDir, '--log-level', currentLogLevel], { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], detached: false, windowsHide: true })` per N-007 §9.1.
  - Pipes helper stdout/stderr to `app.getPath('logs')/main.log` via a rotating writer; tails them as `engine.logLine` events when `diagnosticsVerbosity >= debug`.
- Add a `electron/engine-rpc.ts` (or similar) JSON-RPC client:
  - Connects to the socket once the helper is spawned.
  - Implements the same length-prefixed framing as the helper (4-byte big-endian length, 1 MiB cap).
  - Supports request/response (with id) and notification handlers.
  - Surfaces a typed method facade: `rpc.engine.version()`, `rpc.engine.health()`, etc. — one method per N-007 §5 entry. Methods are camelCase on the TS side; the wire payload uses snake_case per the design.
  - On disconnect, rejects all in-flight RPCs with `{ code: 'helper-disconnected' }` and notifies the supervisor.
- Boot sequence per N-007 §9.1:
  1. Compute paths.
  2. Run orphan/adopt check.
  3. Spawn helper.
  4. Connect socket with retry (≤ 5 s total, exponential backoff).
  5. Invoke `engine.version`; verify `protocolVersion` matches the bundled main-side constant (initially `1`); on mismatch, transition to `engine.unavailable` with reason `helper-protocol-mismatch`.
  6. Verify helper binary SHA-256 against bundled `<helperBinary>.sha256` sidecar (per N-007 §6 and the global release rule). On mismatch, refuse to use and transition to `engine.unavailable` with reason `helper-binary-tampered`. For dev builds without a sidecar, the check is skipped with a `warn`-level log; this is gated behind `app.isPackaged`.
- Restart loop per N-007 §9.2: immediate, +2 s, +10 s; after 3 failures within 60 s → `helper-unavailable` (sticky until manual `engine.restart`).
- Shutdown sequence per N-007 §9.2: on `app.quit()` send `engine.shutdown { deadlineMs: 5000 }`; SIGTERM after 5 s; SIGKILL after 7 s; unlink socket + PID files.
- Heartbeat: invoke `engine.health` on a 5 s tick when no other RPC is in flight. Cache the result; expose via `coveApi.engine.status()` in a future ticket.
- Emit lifecycle events that T-014 will hook: a `EngineSupervisor` EventEmitter with `ready`, `crashed`, `stateChanged`, `logLine`, `unavailable` events.
- Add a top-level integration point in `electron/main.ts`: instantiate the supervisor in `app.whenReady()` and tear it down on `before-quit`. Keep diffs surgical — do NOT touch v1.1.0 MediaRecorder code, do NOT remove or reshape the existing recorder/ffmpeg integration. The supervisor runs alongside the legacy path. v1.1.0 functionality remains the user-visible default until T-020 flips it.

Out of scope (binding):
- No preload changes (`electron/preload.ts`) — T-014.
- No renderer changes — T-014/T-020.
- No removal of v1.1.0 MediaRecorder code. The legacy path stays untouched.
- No PipeWire / encoder / segment / export logic — those live in the helper across T-016..T-019.
- No real `capture.*` / `replay.*` calls; the supervisor is wired but the helper still returns `not-implemented` for everything except `engine.*`.
- No packaging changes (`electron-builder.yml`, package.json). T-020 or T-010d wires `extraResources`.
- No CI changes.

Acceptance criteria:
1. With the helper from T-011/T-012 built locally, launching the Electron app in dev causes:
   - The supervisor spawns the helper.
   - `engine.version` succeeds.
   - The `engine.ready` notification reaches the supervisor.
2. Killing the helper PID externally (`kill -9 $(cat $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cove-screen-recorder/engine.pid)`) triggers the restart loop:
   - Attempt 1 immediate, attempt 2 +2 s, attempt 3 +10 s.
   - After 3 failures within 60 s, the supervisor emits `unavailable` with reason and stops.
3. Cleanly quitting Electron sends `engine.shutdown`, the helper exits within 5 s, and `pgrep cove-replay-engine` returns nothing 5 s later.
4. A stale PID file pointing to a dead PID is unlinked on next boot; a stale PID file pointing to a live same-user same-comm helper is adopted (no respawn).
5. A SHA-256 sidecar mismatch (simulate by truncating the sidecar) refuses helper boot with reason `helper-binary-tampered` in packaged mode; in dev mode the check is skipped with a warn log.
6. The TypeScript types for the JSON-RPC client method facade match the helper's N-007 §5 method list, method-for-method.

Verification commands:
- `cargo build -p cove-replay-engine` (from T-011 — required for the supervisor to spawn anything)
- `npm run build` (or repo-equivalent — check package.json scripts before assuming)
- `npm run typecheck` (or repo-equivalent)
- Manual: `npm run electron:dev` (or repo-equivalent); watch the main log for supervisor lifecycle entries.
- Manual restart-loop test: `kill -9 $(cat $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cove-screen-recorder/engine.pid)` and verify restart attempts.
- Manual clean-quit test: quit Electron and verify `pgrep cove-replay-engine` is empty after 5 s.
- `git status --short`

Codex review expectations:
- Confirm orphan/adopt logic refuses cross-user PIDs (N-007 §10.1).
- Confirm helper SHA-256 sidecar check is enforced in packaged builds and skipped only when `app.isPackaged` is false.
- Confirm restart loop budgets match N-007 §9.2 (3 attempts within 60 s).
- Confirm v1.1.0 MediaRecorder code path is untouched.
- Confirm no `extraResources` / electron-builder edits leak into this ticket.
- Confirm JSON-RPC client framing matches the helper (4-byte big-endian length, 1 MiB cap).
- Flag any leaked Node `fs.readFileSync` or sync work on the main event loop during boot beyond what is absolutely required for SHA-256 verification.

Failure handling:
- If wiring the supervisor into `electron/main.ts` triggers a TypeScript regression, fix the type error inline; do not disable strict mode or add `// @ts-ignore` to leak the regression downstream.

No commits, tags, or publishes from this ticket.
title: Implement Electron main helper supervisor
